entities.name: Jekelth Blackeye
entities.description: Anaba minotaur warrior from Ulgrotha, called Dream by humans, a legendary and cunning fighter.

entities.name: Arras
entities.description: Recounted Jekelth's story to ease Thexar's passing.

entities.name: Thexar
entities.description: Person whose passing Arras eased with Jekelth's story.

entities.name: Pikepierce
entities.description: Renegade goblin whom Jekelth manipulated and defeated.

entities.name: Battle for Strongrock
entities.description: Battle where Jekelth pursued fleeing enemies into the mountains.

events.summary: In the Battle for Strongrock Jekelth pursues fleeing enemies deep into the mountains.
events.quote: Jekelth's relentless pursuit of fleeing enemies

events.summary: Ambushed with a broken knee, Jekelth trades his eyepatch and story to the eldest enemy soldier.
events.quote: By surrendering his eyepatch and recounting the story of how he came by it

events.summary: Jekelth feigns vulnerability and defeats Pikepierce at the cost of an eye.
events.quote: The loss of his eye became a strategic sacrifice

events.summary: Jekelth reclaims his eyepatch and kills the old human soldier.
events.quote: Jekelth seized the moment to reclaim his prize and eliminate his enemy

relations.quote: Jekelth used his enemy's arrogance against him
